name: tennis-clipper
description: AllSportsLive TENNIS Clipper - its own local program next to vMix (TennisClipper.exe, port 5009, asl-tn-clipper://): every tennis point becomes a clip (7 s before / 3 s after the point by default; the match's own window wins) cut from the vMix recording, filed by set, game and player, uploaded to the website's tennis ingest. Completely separate from the Cricket Clipper (clipper-helper/, ClipperHelper.exe) and the Volleyball Clipper (volleyball-clipper-helper/, VolleyballClipper.exe).

scripts.build: node tn-build-guard.js && pkg tennis-clipper-server.js --targets node18-win-x64 --output TennisClipper.exe
